name: UK energy price cap
summary: Energy cap £1,723; January forecasts range from +16% to +27%
state: The Ofgem cap for October–December is £1,723 a year. Cornwall Insight's latest forecast puts January at £1,999, up 16%, while some supplier-based forecasts point to about +27% (Cornwall Insight; Energy Made Easy). Alert is held under hysteresis until Ofgem announces the January cap by 25 Nov; Brent fell to about $94 on 4 Nov.
for_you: Households on default tariffs face a likely rise in January. Ofgem's guidance explains how the cap works and where to get help with bills.
rubric_hit: Forecast rise 16–27% straddles the 20% Alert line; held pending Ofgem

sources.title: Cornwall Insight — 16% price cap rise forecast in January
Energy Made Easy — Energy price cap January 2027 forecast

why: The Ofgem cap sets bills for most UK households — a direct cost-of-living signal.
drivers: Wholesale gas and power prices, network costs, policy levies.

rubric.normal: Typical dual-fuel cap < £1,700/yr and next forecast change < +5%.
